topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I can't believe this is happening. They're turning the building into condos. Everything's changing, and I don't know how to stop it. This place has been my home for years, a sanctuary from the chaos outside. Now, it's just another investment, another opportunity for someone to profit off the comfort I found here. I keep thinking maybe there’s a way to save it, to keep it as it is, but the walls seem to close in a little more with each passing day. I don’t know where I’ll go or if I can afford to stay. All I know is that the familiar is slipping away, and I’m not sure I can find my footing again.
